Fingerprint.description:
What a stage file was made from.

Attributes:
    inputs: SHA-256 of the content of every input file, by input name.
    settings: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the settings the stage declares.
    stage_version: The version of the stage's own code.
Fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

StemGains.description:
The gain applied to each stem so that none clips (1.0 means untouched).

Attributes:
    lead: Gain of the lead vocals.
    backing: Gain of the backing vocals.
    instrumental: Gain of the instrumental.
    karaoke: Gain of the karaoke mix, applied after mixing.
StemGains.title: StemGains

UsedModel.description:
A model a stem was made with.

Attributes:
    name: The registry name.
    revision: The pinned revision.
UsedModel.title: UsedModel

description:
``separation.json``: how the stems were made.

Attributes:
    keep_backing: Whether the karaoke mix keeps the backing vocals.
    models: The models used, vocals first.
    stems: The stem files relative to the work folder.
    samples: The length of every stem in samples.
    sample_rate: Their sample rate.
    gains: The headroom gains applied.
    device: The device used.
    seconds: How long the separation took.
    peak_vram_gib: The most GPU memory used, or ``None`` on the CPU.
    warnings: What the fan should know, for example the fallback to the CPU.
title: SeparationFile
